DA_MT_on_built = {   # the mage tower's on_built: the player chooses its kind, the AI takes its best school
	if = { limit = { owner = { ai = no } } province_event = { id = DA_MT.2 } }
	if = { limit = { owner = { ai = yes } } DA_MT_ai_pick = yes }
}
DA_MT_ai_pick = {   # the AI ruler's best school, else Evocation
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_MT_has_kind = yes } owner = { is_overall_abjuration_level_3 = yes } } DA_MT_set_kind_1 = yes }

	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_MT_has_kind = yes } owner = { is_overall_evocation_level_1 = yes } } DA_MT_set_kind_5 = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_MT_has_kind = yes } owner = { is_overall_illusion_level_1 = yes } } DA_MT_set_kind_6 = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_MT_has_kind = yes } owner = { is_overall_necromancy_level_1 = yes } } DA_MT_set_kind_7 = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_MT_has_kind = yes } owner = { is_overall_transmutation_level_1 = yes } } DA_MT_set_kind_8 = yes }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_MT_has_kind = yes } } DA_MT_set_kind_5 = yes }
}

# ---------------------------------------- country scope
# The networks: counts, best tier and level of each kind; the hidden modifiers; the schools' spells.
# DA_MT_refresh only fires the hidden event DA_MT.3, which runs DA_MT_refresh_now: EU4 copies a scripted
# effect into every place that calls it when the game loads, and this one is called from hundreds (doc 111).
DA_MT_refresh = {
	hidden_effect = { country_event = { id = DA_MT.3 } }
}

		if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_MT_net_10 value = 2 } NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Elemental_Magic_Water.2 } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_MT_net.Elemental_Magic_Water.2 duration = -1 hidden = yes } }

		# Earth

		# Runesmithing

		if = { limit = { NOT = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_MT_net_17 value = 3 } } has_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Runesmithing.3 } remove_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Runesmithing.3 }

		if = { limit = { is_variable_equal = { which = DA_MT_net_18 value = 3 } NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_net.Precursor_Research.3 } } add_country_modifier = { name = DA_MT_net.Precursor_Research.3 duration = -1 hidden = yes } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_MT_towers value = 1 } } set_country_flag = DA_MT_active }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_MT_towers value = 1 } } } clr_country_flag = DA_MT_active }
	}
}
DA_MT_window_numbers = {   # the Secondary Technologies window opens or changes tab (DA_SCH_refresh)
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = mage_tower } DA_MT_has_kind = yes } DA_MT_clear_kind = yes }
		DA_MT_refresh = yes
		if = { limit = { NOT = { check_variable = { which = DA_MT_sel value = 1 } } } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_sel value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_ww_mil value = 100 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_ww_mil value = 80 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_ww_mil value = 60 } }
		if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_ww_mil value = 40 } }
		set_variable = { which = DA_MT_ww_mil20 which = DA_MT_ww_mil }
		change_variable = { which = DA_MT_ww_mil20 value = 20 }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_law_cd.Universal_Law_Life } } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_13 value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_law_cd.Universal_Law_Death } } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_14 value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_law_cd.Universal_Law_Time } } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_15 value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_law_cd.Universal_Law_Space } } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_16 value = 0 } }
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_modifier = DA_MT_tutor_cd } } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_tutor_left value = 0 } }
	}
}
DA_MT_yearly = {   # every country with a mage tower (or a network to take off), once a year
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { ai = no } every_owned_province = { limit = { NOT = { has_building = mage_tower } DA_MT_has_kind = yes } DA_MT_clear_kind = yes } }
		if = { limit = { ai = yes } every_owned_province = { limit = { has_building = mage_tower NOT = { DA_MT_has_kind = yes } } DA_MT_ai_pick = yes } }
		if = {
			limit = {
				ai = yes
				NOT = { DA_AI_level_none = yes }
				DA_completed.Magic_Theory_2 = yes
				treasury = 500
				check_variable = { which = currentMana value = 25 }
				any_owned_province = { has_building = mage_tower DA_MT_tier_1 = yes }
			}
			random_owned_province = { limit = { has_building = mage_tower DA_MT_tier_1 = yes } DA_MT_raise_adept = yes }
			add_treasury = -150
			subtract_variable = { which = currentMana value = 25 }
		}
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_13 value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_13 value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_14 value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_14 value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_15 value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_15 value = 1 } }
		if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_16 value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_MT_law_left_16 value = 1 } }
		DA_MT_refresh = yes
	}
}
DA_MT_monthly = {   # players: the months shown on the Mana page
	hidden_effect = { if = { limit = { check_variable = { which = DA_MT_tutor_left value = 1 } } subtract_variable = { which = DA_MT_tutor_left value = 1 } } }
}

# ---------------------------------------- the commissions
DA_MT_next_gender = {   # the officers alternate: one man, one woman
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_MT_female } set_country_flag = DA_MT_female_was }
	if = { limit = { has_country_flag = DA_MT_female_was } clr_country_flag = DA_MT_female }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = DA_MT_female_was } } set_country_flag = DA_MT_female }
	clr_country_flag = DA_MT_female_was
}
DA_MT_pay_mil_0 = {
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes } add_mil_power = -100 }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes } add_mil_power = -80 }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes } add_mil_power = -60 }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes } add_mil_power = -40 }
}
DA_MT_pay_mil_20 = {
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes } add_mil_power = -120 }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes } add_mil_power = -100 }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes } add_mil_power = -80 }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes } add_mil_power = -60 }
}
DA_MT_define_arcanist = {   # $trait$: the War Wizard's skills, at our Battlemage Academy level
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 0 shock = 7 manuever = 3 siege = 1 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 0 shock = 7 manuever = 3 siege = 1 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 1 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 2 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 1 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 2 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
}
DA_MT_define_elementalist = {   # $trait$: the War Wizard's skills, one level higher
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 1 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 2 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 1 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 2 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
}
DA_MT_define_law = {   # $trait$: the War Wizard's skills, one level higher, at least those of level II
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_general = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
}

DA_MT_define_admiral = {   # $trait$: the Elementalist's skills
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_admiral = { fire = 1 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 2 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_0 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_admiral = { fire = 1 shock = 7 manuever = 5 siege = 2 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_admiral = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_1 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_admiral = { fire = 2 shock = 8 manuever = 6 siege = 3 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_admiral = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_2 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_admiral = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes NOT = { DA_MT_female = yes } } define_admiral = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ name = DA_MT_name_m } }
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_academy_3 = yes DA_MT_female = yes } define_admiral = { fire = 4 shock = 9 manuever = 7 siege = 4 trait = $trait$ female = yes name = DA_MT_name_f } }
}
DA_MT_general = {   # $role$, $trait$
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_new_general_tt
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_stats_$role$_tt
	custom_tooltip = $trait$
	hidden_effect = {
		set_saved_name = { key = DA_MT_name_m type = leader }
		set_saved_name = { key = DA_MT_name_f type = leader female = yes }
		DA_MT_define_$role$ = { trait = $trait$ }
		clear_saved_name = DA_MT_name_m
		clear_saved_name = DA_MT_name_f
		DA_MT_next_gender = yes
	}
}
DA_MT_admiral = {   # $role$, $trait$
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_new_admiral_tt
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_stats_$role$_tt
	custom_tooltip = $trait$
	hidden_effect = {
		set_saved_name = { key = DA_MT_name_m type = leader }
		set_saved_name = { key = DA_MT_name_f type = leader female = yes }
		DA_MT_define_admiral = { trait = $trait$ }
		clear_saved_name = DA_MT_name_m
		clear_saved_name = DA_MT_name_f
		DA_MT_next_gender = yes
	}
}
DA_MT_arcanist_1 = {   # Abjuration
	if = { limit = { DA_MT_best_1_3 = yes } DA_MT_general = { role = arcanist trait = DA_Arcanist_Abjuration_3 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_MT_best_1_3 = yes } DA_MT_best_1_2 = yes } DA_MT_general = { role = arcanist trait = DA_Arcanist_Abjuration_2 } }
	if = { limit = { NOT = { DA_MT_best_1_2 = yes } } DA_MT_general = { role = arcanist trait = DA_Arcanist_Abjuration } }
}

DA_MT_tutor = {   # Anbennar's increase_magic_experience picks the study under way (ruler, heir or country)
	DA_mana_spend = { amount = 20 }
	increase_magic_experience = { amount = 200 }
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_tutor_cd_tt
	hidden_effect = { add_country_modifier = { name = DA_MT_tutor_cd duration = 730 hidden = yes } set_variable = { which = DA_MT_tutor_left value = 24 } }
}
DA_MT_magic_menu_main = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_mm_main_eff_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_ruler_flag = is_a_vampire } set_country_flag = mage_vampire }
		update_magic_menu_effect = yes
		close_all_magic_menus = yes
		set_country_flag = magic_menu_main_flag
		DA_close_main_tech_interface = yes
	}
}
DA_MT_magic_menu_study = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_mm_study_eff_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_ruler_flag = is_a_vampire } set_country_flag = mage_vampire }
		update_magic_menu_effect = yes
		close_all_magic_menus = yes
		set_country_flag = magic_menu_advancement_flag
		DA_close_main_tech_interface = yes
	}
}
DA_MT_magic_menu_spells = {
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_mm_spells_eff_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		if = { limit = { has_ruler_flag = is_a_vampire } set_country_flag = mage_vampire }
		update_magic_menu_effect = yes
		close_all_magic_menus = yes
		set_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_flag
		if = { limit = { NOT = { has_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_abjuration_flag has_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_conjuration_flag has_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_divination_flag has_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_enchantment_flag has_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_evocation_flag has_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_illusion_flag has_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_necromancy_flag has_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_transmutation_flag } } set_country_flag = magic_menu_spellbook_divination_flag }
		DA_close_main_tech_interface = yes
	}
}
DA_MT_assign_free = {   # the Towers page: each free tower in turn, until none is left or the player stops
	custom_tooltip = DA_MT_assign_eff_tt
	hidden_effect = {
		every_owned_province = { limit = { has_province_flag = DA_MT_skip } clr_province_flag = DA_MT_skip }
		set_country_flag = DA_MT_assigning
		random_owned_province = { limit = { DA_MT_free_tower = yes } province_event = { id = DA_MT.2 } }
	}
}
